metadata.title: High velocity stars from close interaction of a globular cluster and a super massive black hole

notes: No eligible individual stars. The paper is a theoretical three-body scattering study of anonymous test stars; MACHO 176.18833.411 is mentioned only as a “runaway RR Lyrae variable star” possibly produced by the proposed mechanism, without an explicit or accepted claim that it is presently unbound from the Milky Way (T:p13-b13).
